note: Every candidate, company, role, and rating in this corpus is invented. It exists so the benchmark harness, its thresholds, and its record can be exercised end to end before the recruiter's real frozen corpus arrives, and it is not a substitute for that corpus. No real candidate information appears in this repository. Structured labels use the product's own field vocabulary from internal/profile/taxonomy.go: labels written in any other field names could never match, however well a model performed.
